items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 5:41 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

Councillor C. Michaud joined the meeting at this time.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

items.title: National Day of Remembrance of the Québec City Mosque Attack & Action against Islamophobia
notes: Mayor B. Vrbanovic acknowledged the National Day of Remembrance of the Québec City Mosque Attack & Action against Islamophobia.

items.title: International Holocaust Remembrance Day
notes: Mayor B. Vrbanovic acknowledged International Holocaust Remembrance Day, observed each year on January 27.

items.title: Mayoral Business and Updates - Mayor B. Vrbanovic
Recess and Reconvene
notes: The Special Council meeting then recessed at 5:46p.m. and reconvened at 6:52 p.m., chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic with all members present. Councillors M. Johnston and C. Michaud were participating virtually.

items.title: City Facility - Lease Agreement (Land Disposition - Section 239 (2) (c))
To confirm all actions and proceedings of the Council for January 26, 2026.
Adjournment
notes: On motion the meeting adjourned at 6:53 p.m.

motions.item_title: Council Member Appointments to Boards and Committees
motions.text: "That the Council Member Appointments to Boards and Committees be deferred to the Special Council meeting on February 2, 2026, to allow all members to be in attendance in-person."
motions.text_html: "That the Council Member Appointments to Boards and Committees be deferred to the Special Council meeting on February 2, 2026, to allow all members to be in attendance in-person."

motions.text: "That an in-camera meeting of City Council be held immediately following the special council meeting this date to consider three items, a land disposition matter, a labour relations matter; a solicitor client privilege matter; and, a procurement procedure and solicitor client privilege matter as authorized by Sections 239 (2) (c) (d) (f) and (k) of the Municipal Act, 2001, respectively."
motions.text_html: "That an in-camera meeting of City Council be held immediately following the special council meeting this date to consider three items, a land disposition matter, a labour relations matter; a solicitor client privilege matter; and, a procurement procedure and solicitor client privilege matter as authorized by Sections 239 (2) (c) (d) (f) and (k) of the Municipal Act, 2001, respectively."

motions.item_title: City Facility - Lease Agreement (Land Disposition - Section 239 (2) (c))
motions.text: “That the General Manager, Community Services and Deputy CAO be authorized to approve and execute a Lease agreement for the provision of services at the Kitchener Memorial Auditorium Complex (The Aud) in accordance with the terms and conditions discussed at the in-camera meeting of Council on January 26, 2026, and to the satisfaction of the City Solicitor.”
motions.text_html: “That the General Manager, Community Services and Deputy CAO be authorized to approve and execute a Lease agreement for the provision of services at the Kitchener Memorial Auditorium Complex (The Aud) in accordance with the terms and conditions discussed at the in-camera meeting of Council on January 26, 2026, and to the satisfaction of the City Solicitor.”

motions.text: "That the terms and conditions contained in the Memorandum of Settlement dated December 17, 2025, to establish the 2026-2029 Collective Agreement with CUPE 68 Civics be approved; and, That the terms and conditions contained in the Memorandum of Settlement dated December 17, 2025, to establish the 2026-2029 Collective Agreement with CUPE 68 Mechanics be approved; and further, That the Mayor and the Clerk be authorized to execute documentation arising there from."
